image_description: An underwater shot of a hammerhead shark swimming diagonally from bottom-left to top-right. The shark is viewed from a slightly elevated side angle, showcasing its distinctive cephalofoil (hammer-shaped head), dorsal fin, pectoral fins, and part of the caudal fin. The background is deep blue water with faint outlines of other fish or structures in the distance.
